declaration.preface:
Mars Stitch Ltd. is dedicated to fostering a fair and equitable workplace by ensuring that all employees earn a living wage. A living wage represents the income necessary to meet basic needs such as food, housing, healthcare, education, and other essentials, while also allowing for some discretionary income. This commitment reflects our core values of dignity, respect, and fairness.

At Mars Stitch Ltd., we recognize the transformative impact of living wages on the lives of workers and their families. By embedding living wage principles into our operations, we aim to promote social equity, improve well-being, and contribute to sustainable economic growth.
declaration.declaration: Mars Stitch Ltd. is committed to ensuring that all employees receive a living wage that supports a decent standard of living. By going beyond minimum wage compliance, we aim to establish a benchmark for fair compensation in the textile and garment industry. Through transparency, regular monitoring, and continuous improvement, we will uphold this commitment across all levels of the organization.

definitions.title: Living Wage Definition & Methodology
definitions.content:
A living wage represents the income necessary to meet basic needs such as food, housing, healthcare, education, and other essentials, while also allowing for some discretionary income.

Mars Stitch Ltd. focuses on the following principles to achieve living wage commitments:

Wage Fairness: Ensure that wages paid to employees meet or exceed living wage benchmarks established by organization.

Continuous Improvement: Regularly review and update wage benchmarks to reflect changes in the cost of living and evolving global standards.

Mars Stitch Ltd. is committed to ensuring that all employees receive a living wage that supports a decent standard of living.

This policy applies exclusively to all employees, workers, contractors, contractual worker, subcontractors, internal and external stakeholders of Mars Stitch Ltd. across all operational sites.

This policy will be reviewed annually by the Manager - HR, Admin & Compliance, ensuring alignment with Mars Stitch Ltd.'s living wage commitments and global standards. The Wage Compliance Office will assess the policy's effectiveness, incorporating employee feedback and addressing emerging challenges.

Wage Fairness: Establish and implement living wage benchmarks across all operational sites.
Ensure all employees receive fair wages that enable them to meet basic needs.
Provide additional benefits such as healthcare, education support, and housing assistance to enhance employees' quality of life.
Transparency and Monitoring: Conduct annual wage Calculation to ensure compliance with living wage standards.
Publish annual reports detailing wage practices and progress toward achieving living wage goals.
Establish grievance mechanisms to address employee concerns related to wage payments.
Worker Empowerment: Engage with employees through surveys and forums to gather insights on wage adequacy.
Provide channels for employees to report wage-related grievances anonymously and securely.
Offer financial literacy programs to help employees manage their income effectively.
Continuous Improvement: Regularly review and update wage benchmarks to reflect changes in the cost of living and evolving global standards.
Public Commitment: Announce living wage targets publicly, reinforcing transparency and demonstrating leadership in ethical wage practices.
Sustained Living Wage Commitment: Maintain a long-term commitment to continuously paying living wages, ensuring that wage standards evolve alongside economic and social changes.

targets.target: Ensure 100% of employees receive wages meeting living wage benchmarks
Provide additional non-monetary benefits, covering 80% of employees
Conduct annualy reviews of wage compliance metrics, aiming to achieve a 20% improvement in compliance scores year-on-year
Resolve 90% of wage-related grievances within 30 days of reporting
Conduct annual financial literacy workshops for 100% of employees
Establish anonymous grievance mechanisms accessible to all employees
